verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page claims a Google Maps integration with automatic mileage calculations, which covers map-based mileage logging. Per diem appears only as a travel-booking feature that shows allowable spend and adjusts by trip location and duration; nothing shows an employee claiming a per-diem rate as a reimbursement. missing for 10: evidence of per-diem reimbursement claims (as opposed to travel spend guidance), detailed docs on the mileage logging flow (route entry, rate application, submission), independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.
